Container.Name: LanGuard
Container.Overview:
LanGuard is a modern, self-hosted network visibility and monitoring tool for discovering, organizing, and tracking devices on your local network (LAN).
[b]NOTE: Coordinated 3-Container Setup[/b] LanGuard runs as a coordinated 3-service stack using host networking: 1. [b]LanGuard[/b] (this template): Next.js web frontend & Caddy reverse proxy on port 8080. 2. [b]LanGuard-Backend[/b]: Django REST API, background worker, and SQLite database on port 8000. 3. [b]LanGuard-Scanner[/b]: Layer 2 ARP scanner, port prober, and task scheduler. [i]Make sure to install LanGuard-Backend and LanGuard-Scanner alongside this template, or deploy via Unraid's Docker Compose Manager using upstream's docker-compose.yaml.[/i]
[b]Key Features:[/b] - [b]Automated Device Discovery:[/b] Discovers IPv4 devices, vendors, MAC addresses, open ports, and active network services. - [b]State & History Tracking:[/b] Monitors online/offline availability, IP changes, and device attention alerts. - [b]Inventory Organization:[/b] Organize devices by room, role, custom icon, and notes (regular, visitor, IoT, archived). - [b]SNMP & DNS Integrations:[/b] Discovers switches, APs, and printers via read-only SNMP v2c. Integrates with AdGuard Home, Pi-hole, Technitium, Speedtest Tracker, and HomeBox. - [b]Multi-Channel Alerts:[/b] Instant notifications to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, or custom webhooks when unknown devices appear. - [b]Wake-on-LAN:[/b] Wake asleep devices directly from the web interface.
[b]Initial Setup:[/b] 1. Install [b]LanGuard-Backend[/b] first and configure a shared [inline]SECRET_KEY[/inline]. 2. Install [b]LanGuard-Scanner[/b] using the same [inline]SECRET_KEY[/inline]. 3. Install [b]LanGuard[/b] (Frontend) and open [inline]http://[IP]:8080[/inline] to create your admin account.
